* Champion: Yasuo

* New model and texture
* Supports all champion texture quality settings
* Modified loadingscreen
* Modified in-game/skill icons
* Modified particles
* New voiceover

## Credits

* Thanks Guisai, tarngaina , PoonNotaniShsui for helping me with the model and VO packs.

* **TURN OFF DX9LegacyMode because it make the gaem crash when u using this skin ( Loading 98% )**.
